coverage_override.reason: The Special Summon trigger and its hard once-per-turn sentence form one effect; the material-granted Quick Effect and its once-per-turn sentence form the second effect.

effects.printed_clause: When a Shining Brigade monster is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon this card from your GY or banishment. You can only use this effect once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: A GY/banishment trigger checks the event group for a face-up Shining Brigade monster, verifies the handler can be Special Summoned, revives it, and uses the card id as a hard once-per-turn key.

official_references.matched_structure: Performs a legal GY Special Summon during resolution.
Uses an id-keyed once-per-turn limit for the trigger.

effects.printed_clause: A Shining Brigade monster that has this card as material gains: Once per turn, during the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can roll a 6-sided die; banish cards from your opponent's GY up to half the number rolled (rounded up).
effects.lua_implementation: EVENT_BE_MATERIAL grants the qualifying Xyz Monster a Main Phase Quick Effect. Its target step declares the dice/removal categories; its operation rolls the die and then lets the controller banish between one and ceil(result/2) eligible opposing GY cards.

official_references.matched_structure: Registers an effect associated with a card used as Xyz Material.
Calls Duel.TossDice during the resolving operation, after players had the opportunity to respond.

effects.issue: Fixed: the die roll was moved from target declaration to resolution, so its result is not exposed before the Chain resolves.
